items.optimization: Run exact-ID/title lookup before semantic search
items.mechanism: Exact identifiers should not pay embedding/rerank cost or risk semantic false positives
items.test: Compare exact-known-item queries through exact-first vs hybrid-only

items.optimization: Scope by domain/project/security before ranking
items.mechanism: Remove impossible/disallowed candidates before expensive relevance scoring
items.failure_mode: Wrong metadata can exclude relevant item

items.optimization: Apply cheap lexical+dense candidate generation before expensive reranker
items.mechanism: Reserve strong scorer for a small high-recall pool
items.failure_mode: Weak stage-1 recall irreversibly loses item

items.optimization: Tune candidate-pool size by measured recall, not arbitrary top-k
items.mechanism: Use smallest pool that meets high-recall threshold

items.optimization: Tune final context-k separately from retrieval candidate-k
items.mechanism: Broad search does not imply broad prompt injection
items.failure_mode: Too-small final k misses complementary evidence

items.optimization: Deduplicate overlapping chunks before prompt packing
items.mechanism: Avoid repeating same facts/window overlap
items.failure_mode: Dedup can remove useful repeated qualifier

items.optimization: Merge adjacent selected chunks from same source into one window
items.mechanism: Recover continuity without duplicated overlap boilerplate
items.failure_mode: Merged window can reintroduce irrelevant text

items.optimization: Keep source title/section/date beside each retrieved span
items.mechanism: Make provenance and temporal scope immediately available to synthesis model

items.optimization: Boost exact rare terms after semantic candidate retrieval
items.mechanism: Protect error codes/names/IDs from semantic dilution

items.optimization: Treat recency as a feature only for time-sensitive facts
items.mechanism: Avoid biasing timeless authoritative sources toward newer but weaker material

items.optimization: Downrank superseded claims rather than deleting them
items.mechanism: Keep historical truth available while preferring current state

items.optimization: Co-retrieve a credible contradiction when selected evidence is contested
items.mechanism: Prevent one-sided synthesis

items.optimization: Generate query variants only after baseline retrieval confidence/coverage is low
items.mechanism: Avoid paying query-expansion cost routinely
items.failure_mode: Gate may miss hidden recall failure

items.optimization: Limit generated query variants and measure marginal unique-relevant gain
items.mechanism: Prevent RAG-Fusion query explosion
items.failure_mode: Small variant cap can miss perspective

items.optimization: Require generated query variant remain semantically tied to original request
items.mechanism: Reduce query drift

items.optimization: Never treat pseudo-document/query-expansion text as evidence
items.mechanism: Keep synthetic retrieval aids out of factual provenance

items.optimization: Cache deterministic query normalization/entity resolution
items.mechanism: Avoid repeating preprocessing on frequent entities

items.optimization: Cache reranking only against immutable candidate/version hashes
items.mechanism: Avoid stale rank results after source/index changes

items.optimization: Measure retrieval failure separately from synthesis failure
items.mechanism: Do not tune generator when evidence was absent, or retrieval when generator ignored good evidence

items.optimization: Sample context-ablation runs for high-cost sources
items.mechanism: Learn whether a retrieved memory/library materially changes outcomes

items.optimization: Randomize A/B output order for model judges
items.mechanism: Remove fixed position advantage
items.failure_mode: Doubles some evals if both orders used

items.optimization: Blind model/provider identity in judge prompt
items.mechanism: Reduce brand/model priors
items.failure_mode: Output style may still reveal model

items.optimization: Blind candidate implementation rationale when evaluating artifact correctness
items.mechanism: Prevent persuasive explanation from biasing reviewer
items.failure_mode: Some rationale is relevant to intended semantics

items.optimization: Separate correctness, completeness, style, cost and safety rubrics
items.mechanism: Prevent one attractive dimension from masking a critical regression

items.optimization: Use hard veto criteria for security/privacy invariants
items.mechanism: Do not average catastrophic failure into a good total score
items.failure_mode: Could block release on false-positive gate

items.optimization: Report mean plus tail/worst-case on repeated stochastic evals
items.mechanism: Avoid hiding unstable catastrophic cases behind average

items.optimization: Track variance across repeated identical tasks
items.mechanism: Detect nondeterministic fragility
items.failure_mode: Provider backend variation may be unavoidable

items.optimization: Record exact prompt/model/tool/schema versions with every eval run
items.mechanism: Make comparisons reproducible and attributable

items.optimization: Store environment/machine info for latency/performance benchmarks
items.mechanism: Prevent hardware changes from being misattributed to AI improvement

items.optimization: Warm-cache and cold-cache benchmarks separately
items.mechanism: Avoid reporting cache benefit as general compute speedup

items.optimization: Use cost per successful task, not cost per call, as primary economic metric
items.mechanism: Cheap failures/retries can cost more than an expensive successful route

items.optimization: Exclude infrastructure quota/outage failures from model-quality score but retain reliability metric
items.mechanism: Do not confuse capability with availability while still measuring provider dependability
items.failure_mode: User experiences both, so total route metric must also include availability

items.optimization: Track human corrections as first-class failures even when automated tests pass
items.mechanism: Tests do not capture all user utility
items.failure_mode: Correction may reflect preference rather than correctness

items.optimization: Turn verified production failure into regression case before fixing when feasible
items.mechanism: Ensure repair is measurable and permanent
items.failure_mode: Urgent incident may require fix first

items.optimization: Keep fixed anchor suite plus rolling recent suite
items.mechanism: Preserve longitudinal comparability while adapting to new workloads

items.optimization: Reserve an optimizer-inaccessible holdout
items.mechanism: Measure real generalization of prompt/workflow search

items.optimization: Rotate/refresh part of holdout over time without exposing future cases
items.mechanism: Reduce long-term contamination

items.optimization: Check judge consistency before trusting judge score changes smaller than its noise
items.mechanism: Avoid optimizing within evaluator variance

items.optimization: Escalate material judge disagreement instead of majority-voting it away
items.mechanism: Preserve uncertainty where evidence conflicts

items.optimization: Normalize/record output length when judging style/quality
items.mechanism: Detect verbosity bias
items.failure_mode: Length can legitimately correlate with completeness

items.optimization: Run metamorphic paraphrase tests on prompts before promotion
items.mechanism: Detect brittle dependence on incidental wording
items.failure_mode: Some wording differences are semantically meaningful

items.optimization: Run irrelevant-context injection tests
items.mechanism: Detect distraction/context-pollution sensitivity

items.optimization: Run reorder tests for independent context blocks/tools/examples
items.mechanism: Detect positional sensitivity

items.optimization: Use mutation testing to validate new deterministic tests
items.mechanism: Prevent generated tests that merely encode current implementation

items.optimization: Shrink adversarial/failing prompts to minimal reproducer
items.mechanism: Improve diagnosis and durable regression quality
items.failure_mode: Shrunk prompt may change model stochastic behavior
